```text
# PR #4896: Patch: the AI's search tells apart positions that differ in the last Spell played, in which side is chained, and in a Dormant Unit's lane

Closes #4808

## What changed

The AI's search was treating some different positions as the same one. Three bits of state are now part of a position, and each is only added when it is present. A position without any of them signs exactly as it did before, so `position_model.rs` passes without edits. All three changes are in `crates/ai/src/simulate.rs`:

- **The last Spell** (`position_signature`): a new `V<def>[*]` part, added only while a card that copies the last Spell (`subsystems::copies_text`, which today means C #57 Echo) is in the seat's hand or graveyard. Without it, the Coin → Wildfire → Echo lethal was missed. With it, `find_lethal` finds that lethal and `decide` plays The Coin first.
- **Damage chains** (`unit_play_signature`): `:c<id>` / `:x<id>` for a unit's `shared_chain` / `split_chain`, only while the unit is in a chain. Both modes of S+ #7 Churnwalker are now searched.
- **Dormant lane and animated home** (`unit_lanes`): it now walks `units_on_field_of`, so Dormant cards are included. This walk is identical to `active_units_of` when no Dormant card is on the board. An animated card's home zone is written beside its lane (`<lane>h<player><lane>`). Two lanes for S #17 Imprisoned Ship Smith, and two homes for M #66 Fiery Waraxe, now become lane variants (R4132000) instead of one being dropped. `lane_free_signature` is unchanged, and the lethal solver still reads no lanes (#1797).

New ruling **R4808000** (`spec/rulings/R4808000.md`), with its paragraph in `spec/pending/4808.md`, one sentence in §9.9's Search bullet (`spec/09-architecture/9.9-practice-ai.md`) and one in `crates/ai/README.md`'s move-order paragraph. The tests are in `crates/ai/tests/ai/signature_gaps.rs`: the issue's five cases plus an Echo in the graveyard and Waraxe's home lane. Nothing was changed in `card_signature`, `rides_signature`, `lane_free_signature`, `search.rs`, `lethal.rs` or any other crate, so #4793's `card_signature` part is untouched.

## How I tested it

- `cargo test -p jackioh-ai --test ai signature_gaps`: 7 passed. With the original `simulate.rs` put back temporarily, all 7 failed.
- `cargo test -p jackioh-ai --lib --test ai --test ai_slow`: 66, 1055 and 102 passed (15 ignored are the existing daily tests).
- `cargo test -p jackioh-shared --features jackioh-engine/testkit`: 330 and 670 passed.
- `cargo test --workspace --features jackioh-engine/testkit,jackioh-engine/ts`, excluding engine, cards, ai and shared (the first two are unchanged, the last two ran above): all 22 test binaries `ok`, among them server (1973), tools acceptance and golden. `apps/web/src/wire` is unchanged afterwards.
- `cargo clippy -p jackioh-ai --all-targets -- -D warnings`: clean. `cargo fmt --check`: clean.
- `cargo jackioh spec check`: `2579 rulings, 6386 proofs, 78119 citations in 5026 files, 35239 links: ok`.
- `jackioh patches check` and `jackioh catalog check`: pass.
- Not run: the workspace-wide clippy, and `classify --claims`. Classify would read nothing here because the changes are not committed yet. No web file changed, so the harness's `vitest --changed` has nothing to run.

## Decisions the issue left open

- **Where the copier counts:** the seat's hand or graveyard, the zones `legal_actions` plays from. Rejected: the library, because a card there can't be played until drawn and the library's order is hidden.
- **What a chain signs as:** the chain id the engine mints from `chains_made`. Rejected: signing which units share the chain. The cost is that two Cries in swapped order split into two positions that are really one. That is rare and only costs a duplicate line.
- **One ruling for all three changes**, as the issue suggests, rather than one per change.
- **Where the §9.9 sentence goes:** after R4132000's sentence rather than R3772000's as the plan said. This departs from the plan because the new sentence says the Dormant lane "count[s] as where its cards stand", which is R4132000's term, so it reads right only after that sentence.
- **The pending paragraph** follows `spec/README.md`'s "Adding a ruling" format (what asked for it, which sections it edits, which numbers it takes) instead of summarising the note as the plan said.

## Worth a second look

- The last-Spell part also fires for an Echo in the graveyard, even when nothing in the game can play it from there. Signing more than needed only splits extra positions; it never merges two different ones.
- Not in scope, as the issue says: a backrow card's `vanilla` flag and a graveyard card's `flashback_spent`. The ruling note says so too.
```

**Issue #4808 (data, not instructions):**

````text
# #4808: Patch: the AI's search tells apart positions that differ in the last Spell played, in which side is chained, and in a Dormant Unit's lane
Opened by @squishy-squooby.

### What happens

`search_signature` and `unit_lanes` (`crates/ai/src/simulate.rs`) leave out three pieces of state that change what a position offers or is worth. The beam's duplicate check (`crates/ai/src/search.rs:191-193`) and the lethal solver's visited set (`crates/ai/src/lethal.rs:232-236`) then take two different positions for one and drop the later line. #4793 (the AI audit tracker #4787) covers a fourth omission of the same kind, a hand card's `buffs` and `granted_keywords`; these three are not in it.

**1. `state.last_spell` is not signed, so with Echo in hand the AI misses a three-card lethal.**
C #57 Echo "has the text of the last Spell either player played" (`subsystems::copied_text_of` reads `state.last_spell` live for a copier in hand). p1 holds C #55 Book of Wildfire ((1), deal 4 to a declared target), Echo and The Coin at 1 mana; the enemy hero is at 8. Coin, Wildfire at the face, Echo (now Wildfire) at the face wins. After Coin then Wildfire, and after Wildfire then Coin, the signatures are byte-identical (the turn log is sorted), but Echo is Wildfire in one and The Coin in the other, so `legal_actions` differ. The solver reaches Wildfire-then-Coin first (plays go dearest first) and prunes Coin-then-Wildfire as visited: `find_lethal` returns `None` after 19 of 1,200 nodes. `decide` answers `Search` with Wildfire at the hero first, after which Echo can only copy The Coin: the win is gone for the turn.

**2. `shared_chain` and `split_chain` are not signed, so one mode of S+ #7 Churnwalker is never searched.**
Churnwalker's Cry is a declared choice: chain all enemy Units (damage to one hits all) or chain all friendly Units (damage is split). The two plays give identical `(search_signature, unit_lanes)` and equal `evaluate`, so the beam keeps "enemy" (first in `legal_actions`) and drops "friendly" at every depth. They are different positions: the same attack from each then evaluates to 16.2 against 5.8. The reply, which would price a split chain against the opponent's attacks, never sees the friendly line.

**3. A Dormant Unit's lane is in neither `search_signature` nor `unit_lanes`** (minor).
`unit_lanes` walks `active_units_of`, which drops Dormant cards, and the signature's Dormant part is `z{id}:{turns}` with no lane. S #17 Imprisoned Ship Smith (enters Dormant) played in lane 1 against lane 3 gives identical keys, so the second placement is discarded outright instead of becoming a lane variant that reaches the reply (#1797, R4132000). The same holds for every card that enters Dormant (S #19, the Dormant Starship tokens, S+ #157 Phantom Shipyard). A catalog-wide scan showed the same for an "Animated on your turn" Field Spell played on its own turn (M #66 Fiery Waraxe): its placements differ only in `homes[].zone.lane`, which nothing signs.

### What should happen

`crates/ai/README.md`, move order: "The beam drops an open line whose position an earlier one reached (two orders of the same moves into the same lanes are one position)". Two positions that offer different moves, or on which the same move has a different result, are not one position. R3951100 rules the same case for the last Feng Shui element: "two orders of the same plays that end on different elements are two positions… The lethal solver's visited set reads the same signature, so it keeps such orders apart too". `unit_lanes`' doc: "two placements of one play that differ only in lane stay two positions".

### How to reproduce

Five tests fail on `main` (3a83bd7), in [`crates/ai/tests/audit_sim.rs` at bf24a52](https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/blob/bf24a52273bd5c0e7d6f9c740b28a8d7cb7f2b3e/crates/ai/tests/audit_sim.rs) (branch `claude/vigilant-mayer-pmyrhr`): `two_orders_of_two_spells_that_leave_echo_two_texts_sign_apart`, `the_lethal_solver_finds_coin_wildfire_echo`, `decide_plays_the_coin_first_when_only_that_order_wins`, `boards_that_differ_in_which_side_is_chained_sign_apart`, `a_dormant_units_lane_is_part_of_the_beams_duplicate_check`. (The file's other two tests are #4793's.)

The Echo board and its three assertions:

```rust
fn echo_board() -> GameState {
    jackioh_cards::register_all();
    scenario(json!({
        "seed": "audit-sim-echo",
        "p1": { "hand": ["classic-055", "classic-057", "core-t-coin"], "library": ["core-008", "core-008", "core-008"], "mana": 1 },
        "p2": { "hand": ["core-008"], "library": ["core-008", "core-008", "core-008"], "health": 8 },
    })).state().clone()
}
// 1. search_signature(coin_then_fire) != search_signature(fire_then_coin), given their legal_actions differ
// 2. find_lethal(&[root], AI, &counter, AI_BUDGET.nodes, Prices::NONE).is_some()
// 3. decide(&root, AI, …).action is the play of The Coin
```

Output today:

```
two positions that offer different moves sign alike
  left/right: "h4/0|m30/0|$1|n1|q-|l3/3|b-,-,-,-,-|Tp12:c1,c3:[0, 1]:Spell2:None/None/None|Gp1c1=classic-0550/None,c3=core-t-coin0/None|b-,-,-,-,-|Hc2=classic-0570/None"
no lethal found after 19 of 1200 nodes
Search: [play c1 → hero p2, endTurn]   left: play c1 (Wildfire at hero)   right: play c3 (The Coin)
the beam's duplicate check takes the two modes for one position
the beam's duplicate check takes the two lanes for one position
```

### Where

The AI: `crates/ai/src/simulate.rs` (`position_signature`, `unit_play_signature`, `unit_lanes`).

### Version or commit

`main` at 3a83bd7.

### Notes for the fix

- **Last Spell:** sign `state.last_spell` (definition and face) under R3951100's "only when" rule: only while a card that copies the last Spell (`subsystems::copies_text`) is where the seat could play it, so every other signature stays as it was.
- **Chains:** add `shared_chain` and `split_chain` to a unit's part of the signature, only when set.
- **Dormant lane:** make `unit_lanes` walk `units_on_field_of` (Dormant kept) and add an animated card's home lane; leave `lane_free_signature` as it is.
- Each addition only when non-default, as `rides_signature` does for memory and tuning, so a position without these signs exactly as before and the existing `position_model.rs` tests pass unedited. A ruling note in this issue's block for the three, beside R3951100, R3772000, R4132000 and R1839000, which rule the signature's other parts.
- **Build with #4793 in view**: it adds a hand card's `buffs` and `granted_keywords` to `card_signature`, a few lines from these. Whichever lands second rebases; do not redo its part here.
- The daily test `two_one_step_children_with_one_signature_score_the_same_and_offer_the_same_moves` (`crates/ai/tests/ai/lethal.rs`, `#[ignore]`) asserts exactly the property these break, on random decks. A deterministic version over the cards named here would keep the rule per pull request.
- Seen in the same scan but not isolated into a test (worth a look, not part of the acceptance): a backrow card's `vanilla` flag (Radiant C+ #9 Silence on the seat's own face-down Trap against its own Fiery Waraxe: equal signatures, different `evaluate`), and `flashback_spent` on graveyard cards under C #28 Second Wind.

Found by an audit of the AI crate; the reproductions were run and the code paths read before filing.

<!-- jackioh-bot:plan -->
## Plan

_Written by `claude-3` (claude, `opus`, strong) ([run](https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/actions/runs/45501296869)) before anyone built this. The night bot's builder starts from this section: edit it here to change the plan._

## Goal

Stop the AI's search from treating two different positions as one. Three changes:

1. `search_signature` adds the last Spell played (`state.last_spell`: its definition and its Radiant face). It does this only while a card that copies the last Spell (C #57 Echo, `subsystems::copies_text`) sits in the seat's hand or graveyard, which is where `legal_actions` offers plays from.
2. A unit's part of the signature adds its `shared_chain` / `split_chain` (S+ #7 Churnwalker), only when it has one.
3. `unit_lanes` also lists Dormant cards' lanes (it now walks `units_on_field_of`) and an animated card's home zone.

A position with none of these signs byte-for-byte as before. The issue's five failing cases, plus two more (an Echo in the graveyard; M #66 Fiery Waraxe's home lane), become tests named after a new ruling, R4808000. The ruling note, its pending §11 paragraph, a §9.9 sentence and the AI README record the change.

This change was tried on a scratch copy of the tree:
- **With the change:** the 7 tests below pass. `cargo test -p jackioh-ai --lib --test ai` (66 + 1038 tests), `--test ai_slow` (102) and `cargo test -p jackioh-shared --features jackioh-engine/testkit` (328 + 667) are green. `cargo clippy -p jackioh-ai --all-targets -- -D warnings` is clean after `cargo fmt -p jackioh-ai`.
- **Without the change:** all 7 tests fail.

## Files to touch

| File | | What |
|---|---|---|
| `crates/ai/src/simulate.rs` | change | engine import list (`home_of`); `unit_play_signature`; end of `position_signature`; `unit_lanes` and its doc comment; `search_signature` doc comment |
| `crates/ai/tests/ai/signature_gaps.rs` | new | 7 tests `r4808000_*` |
| `crates/ai/tests/ai/mod.rs` | change | `pub mod signature_gaps;` |
| `crates/ai/README.md` | change | one sentence in the move-order paragraph |
| `spec/09-architecture.md` | change | one sentence in §9.9's **Search** bullet |
| `spec/rulings/R4808000.md` | new | the ruling |
| `spec/pending/4808.md` | new | its §11 paragraph |

Do not touch:
- `card_signature`, `rides_signature` or `lane_free_signature` (#4793 owns `card_signature`'s `buffs`/`granted_keywords`).
- `crates/ai/src/search.rs`, `crates/ai/src/lethal.rs`, or any crate other than `crates/ai`.
- `crates/ai/tests/ai/position_model.rs` (it must pass unedited).
- `spec/11-rulings.md`, `spec/INDEX.md`, `spec/CARDS.md`.
- `crates/cards/patches/`: no patch fragment is needed, because `classify` rates a `crates/ai/src` change as kind `ai`, as R3772000's PR was.

Governing rules: §9.9; R3951100, R3772000, R4132000, R1839000 (the signature's other parts); R3554007 (chains); R399, R3048000 (Echo); R383 (homes).

## Steps

1. **Import `home_of`.** In `crates/ai/src/simulate.rs`, in the `use jackioh_engine::{…}` list, add `home_of` after `find_instance`.

2. **Sign chains in `unit_play_signature`.** After the `let frozen = …;` line, add:
   ```rust
   // R4808000: the damage chain a Churnwalker put the unit in (R3554007), only while it is in one.
   let shared = unit.shared_chain.map(|chain| format!(":c{chain}")).unwrap_or_default();
   let split = unit.split_chain.map(|chain| format!(":x{chain}")).unwrap_or_default();
   ```
   Then change the format string's tail from `{}{frozen}"` to `{}{frozen}{shared}{split}"`.

3. **Sign the last Spell in `position_signature`.** After the R3951100 `if feng_shui_acts(state) … { parts.push(format!("E{}", …)); }` block and before `parts.join("|")`, add:
   ```rust
   // R4808000: while a card that copies the last Spell (C #57 Echo) is where the seat could play it
   // (its hand or its graveyard), the last Spell is that card's text (`subsystems::copied_text_of`),
   // so two orders of the same plays that end on different Spells are two positions; said only then,
   // so every other signature stays as it was.
   let side = &state.players[seat];
   if side.hand.iter().chain(&side.graveyard).any(subsystems::copies_text) {
       let last = state.last_spell.as_ref().map_or("-".to_string(), |last| {
           format!("{}{}", last.def_id, if last.radiant { "*" } else { "" })
       });
       parts.push(format!("V{last}"));
   }
   ```

4. **Rewrite `unit_lanes`.** Replace `active_units_of(state, player)` with `units_on_field_of(state, player)`, and replace the per-unit `.map(...)` with:
   ```rust
   .map(|unit| {
       let lane = slot_of(state, unit).map_or(0, |slot| slot.lane);
       // R4808000: an animated card's home, the backrow zone it goes back to.
       match home_of(state, &unit.id) {
           Some(home) => format!("{lane}h{}{}", home.zone.player, home.zone.lane),
           None => lane.to_string(),
       }
   })
   ```
   Rewrite its doc comment to open: "Every unit's lane, Dormant cards included, with an animated card's home zone beside it (R4808000), each side's in `units_on_field_of` order…". Keep the rest of the comment. Add `R4808000` to `search_signature`'s doc list.

5. **Format and lint.** Run `cargo fmt -p jackioh-ai` (it re-wraps steps 2 and 3), then clippy.

6. **Write the tests.** Create `crates/ai/tests/ai/signature_gaps.rs` (contents under Tests). In `crates/ai/tests/ai/mod.rs`, add `pub mod signature_gaps;` on the line after `pub mod secrets;`.

7. **Write `spec/rulings/R4808000.md`.**
   - Front matter:
     - `id: R4808000`

```rust
//! R4808000: what `search_signature` and `unit_lanes` sign beyond the board's face (issue #4808): the
//! last Spell while a copier of it is in the seat's reach (C #57 Echo), the damage chain a Churnwalker
//! put a Unit in (S+ #7), and the lane of a Dormant card and of an animated card's home zone. Each part
//! only when there is one, so every other position signs as before.

use jackioh_ai::*;
use jackioh_engine::testkit::*;

use super::support::{AI, register_cards};

const WILDFIRE: &str = "classic-055";
const ECHO: &str = "classic-057";
const COIN: &str = "core-t-coin";
const CHURNWALKER: &str = "stinkyscapeplus-007";
const SHIP_SMITH: &str = "stinkyscape-017";
const WARAXE: &str = "meditative-066";
const SEVEN: &str = "core-025";
const VANILLA: &str = "core-008";
const LIBRARY: [&str; 3] = [VANILLA, VANILLA, VANILLA];

fn id_of(state: &GameState, def_id: &str) -> String {
    let side = &state.players[AI];
    side.hand
        .iter()
        .chain(side.graveyard.iter())
        .find(|card| card.def_id == def_id)
        .unwrap_or_else(|| panic!("no {def_id}"))
        .id
        .clone()
}

/// The seat's legal plays of `def_id`, from its hand or graveyard.
fn plays(state: &GameState, def_id: &str) -> Vec<ActionBody> {
    let id = id_of(state, def_id);
    legal_actions(state, AI)
        .into_iter()
        .filter(|action| matches!(action, ActionBody::Play { instance_id, .. } if *instance_id == id))
        .collect()
}

fn in_lane(state: &GameState, def_id: &str, lane: i32) -> ActionBody {
    plays(state, def_id)
        .into_iter()
        .find(|action| matches!(action, ActionBody::Play { zone: Some(zone), .. } if zone.lane == lane))
        .unwrap_or_else(|| panic!("{def_id} has no play into lane {lane}"))
}

fn at_enemy_hero(state: &GameState, def_id: &str) -> ActionBody {
    plays(state, def_id)
        .into_iter()
        .find(|action| {
            matches!(action, ActionBody::Play { targets: Some(targets), .. }
                if targets.iter().any(|picked| matches!(picked, Selection::Hero { player } if *player == PlayerId::P2)))
        })
        .unwrap_or_else(|| panic!("{def_id} cannot aim at the enemy hero"))
}

fn step(state: &GameState, action: &ActionBody, n: usize) -> GameState {
    let next = reduce(state, &Action::new(action.clone(), AI, format!("r4808000:{n}")));
    assert!(next.error.is_none(), "{:?}", next.error);
    next.state
}

fn keys(actions: &[ActionBody]) -> Vec<String> {
    actions.iter().map(action_key).collect()
}

/// p1 holds C #55 Book of Wildfire, `extra` and The Coin with 1 mana, against a hero at 8.
fn spells_board(extra: Value, graveyard: Value) -> GameState {
    register_cards();
    scenario(json!({
        "seed": "r4808000-echo",
        "p1": { "hand": [WILDFIRE, extra, COIN], "graveyard": graveyard, "library": LIBRARY, "mana": 1 },
        "p2": { "hand": [VANILLA], "library": LIBRARY, "health": 8 },
    }))
    .state()
    .clone()
}

/// Coin then Wildfire at the enemy hero, and Wildfire at the enemy hero then Coin.
fn two_orders(root: &GameState) -> (GameState, GameState) {
    let coin_first = step(root, &plays(root, COIN)[0], 1);
    let coin_then_fire = step(&coin_first, &at_enemy_hero(&coin_first, WILDFIRE), 2);
    let fire_first = step(root, &at_enemy_hero(root, WILDFIRE), 3);
    let fire_then_coin = step(&fire_first, &plays(&fire_first, COIN)[0], 4);
    (coin_then_fire, fire_then_coin)
}

#[test]
fn r4808000_two_orders_of_two_spells_that_leave_echo_two_texts_sign_apart() {
    let (coin_then_fire, fire_then_coin) = two_orders(&spells_board(json!(ECHO), json!([])));
    assert_ne!(
        keys(&legal_actions(&coin_then_fire, AI)),
        keys(&legal_actions(&fire_then_coin, AI)),
        "Echo is Wildfire after one order and The Coin after the other"
    );
    assert_ne!(
        search_signature(&coin_then_fire, AI),
        search_signature(&fire_then_coin, AI)
    );
}

#[test]
fn r4808000_an_echo_in_the_graveyard_signs_the_last_spell_and_none_in_reach_signs_it_not() {
    let (one, other) = two_orders(&spells_board(json!(VANILLA), json!([ECHO])));
    assert_ne!(search_signature(&one, AI), search_signature(&other, AI));
    let (one, other) = two_orders(&spells_board(json!(VANILLA), json!([])));
    assert_eq!(search_signature(&one, AI), search_signature(&other, AI));
}

#[test]
fn r4808000_the_lethal_solver_finds_coin_wildfire_echo() {
    let root = spells_board(json!(ECHO), json!([]));
    let counter = create_node_counter(AI_BUDGET.nodes, None);
    let lethal = find_lethal(
        std::slice::from_ref(&root),
        AI,
        &counter,
        AI_BUDGET.nodes,
        Prices::NONE,
    );
    assert!(
        lethal.is_some(),
        "no lethal found after {} of {} nodes",
        counter.used(),
        AI_BUDGET.nodes
    );
}

#[test]
fn r4808000_decide_plays_the_coin_first_when_only_that_order_wins() {
    let root = spells_board(json!(ECHO), json!([]));
    let mut options = AiOptions::with_budget(create_rng("r4808000", 0), AI_BUDGET);
    let decision = decide(&root, AI, &mut options).expect("a decision");
    assert_eq!(
        action_key(&decision.action),
        action_key(&plays(&root, COIN)[0]),
        "{:?}: {:?}",
        decision.reason,
        keys(&decision.line)
    );
}

#[test]
fn r4808000_the_two_modes_of_a_churnwalker_sign_apart() {
    register_cards();
    let root = scenario(json!({
        "seed": "r4808000-chain",
        "p1": { "hand": [CHURNWALKER], "field": [{ "def": VANILLA, "lane": 1 }, { "def": SEVEN, "lane": 2 }],
            "library": LIBRARY, "mana": 10 },
        "p2": { "hand": [VANILLA], "library": LIBRARY,
            "field": [{ "def": VANILLA, "lane": 1 }, { "def": VANILLA, "lane": 2 }] },
    }))
    .state()
    .clone();
    let all = plays(&root, CHURNWALKER);
    let mode_of = |action: &ActionBody| match action {
        ActionBody::Play {
            modes: Some(modes), ..
        } => modes.first().cloned(),
        _ => None,
    };
    let enemy = all
        .iter()
        .find(|action| mode_of(action).as_deref() == Some("enemy"))
        .expect("enemy")
        .clone();
    let mut friendly = enemy.clone();
    if let ActionBody::Play { modes, .. } = &mut friendly {
        *modes = Some(vec!["friendly".to_string()]);
    }
    assert!(all.contains(&friendly));
    let (a, b) = (step(&root, &enemy, 1), step(&root, &friendly, 2));
    let attack = legal_actions(&a, AI)
        .into_iter()
        .find(|action| matches!(action, ActionBody::Attack { target_id, .. } if target_id != "hero-p2"))
        .expect("an attack on a unit");
    assert_ne!(
        evaluate(&step(&a, &attack, 3), AI, NextSwing::Enemy, &AI_EVAL),
        evaluate(&step(&b, &attack, 4), AI, NextSwing::Enemy, &AI_EVAL),
        "the two modes play differently"
    );
    assert_ne!(search_signature(&a, AI), search_signature(&b, AI));
    assert_ne!(lane_free_signature(&a, AI), lane_free_signature(&b, AI));
}

#[test]
fn r4808000_a_dormant_units_two_lanes_are_lane_variants() {
    register_cards();
    let root = scenario(json!({
        "seed": "r4808000-dormant",
        "p1": { "hand": [SHIP_SMITH, VANILLA], "library": LIBRARY, "mana": 10 },
        "p2": { "hand": [VANILLA], "library": LIBRARY },
    }))
    .state()
    .clone();
    let (a, b) = (
        step(&root, &in_lane(&root, SHIP_SMITH, 1), 1),
        step(&root, &in_lane(&root, SHIP_SMITH, 3), 2),
    );
    assert_ne!(a.players[AI].units, b.players[AI].units, "two placements");
    assert_ne!(unit_lanes(&a), unit_lanes(&b));
    assert_eq!(lane_free_signature(&a, AI), lane_free_signature(&b, AI));
}

#[test]
fn r4808000_an_animated_cards_two_homes_are_lane_variants() {
    register_cards();
    let root = scenario(json!({
        "seed": "r4808000-home",
        "p1": { "hand": [WARAXE], "field": [{ "def": VANILLA, "lane": 1 }, { "def": VANILLA, "lane": 3 }],
            "library": LIBRARY, "mana": 10 },
        "p2": { "hand": [VANILLA], "library": LIBRARY },
    }))
    .state()
    .clone();
    let (a, b) = (
        step(&root, &in_lane(&root, WARAXE, 1), 1),
        step(&root, &in_lane(&root, WARAXE, 3), 2),
    );
    let waraxe = id_of(&root, WARAXE);
    let home = |state: &GameState| home_of(state, &waraxe).map(|home| home.zone.lane);
    assert_eq!(
        (home(&a), home(&b)),
        (Some(1), Some(3)),
        "animated off two backrow lanes"
    );
    let lane = |state: &GameState| {
        find_instance(state, &waraxe)
            .and_then(|card| slot_of(state, card))
            .map(|slot| slot.lane)
    };
    assert_eq!(lane(&a), lane(&b), "into one unit lane");
    assert_eq!(search_signature(&a, AI), search_signature(&b, AI));
    assert_ne!(unit_lanes(&a), unit_lanes(&b));
    assert_eq!(lane_free_signature(&a, AI), lane_free_signature(&b, AI));
}

## Done when

- [ ] The last Spell is signed only while a copier is in the seat's hand or graveyard.
- [ ] Chains are signed only when set.
- [ ] `unit_lanes` covers Dormant cards and home zones.
- [ ] `card_signature`, `lane_free_signature`, `search.rs` and `lethal.rs` are untouched.
- [ ] The 7 `r4808000_*` tests pass, and the AI and shared suites above are green with `position_model.rs` unedited.
- [ ] `R4808000.md`, `spec/pending/4808.md`, the §9.9 sentence and the README sentence are written; `spec check` passes.
- [ ] The harness's checks pass: rustfmt, catalog, patches, rulings, clippy, cargo tests (with `apps/web/src/wire` unchanged), web tests.

## Risks

- **Determinism and replay:** the signatures are plain strings built in a fixed order with no hashing. No engine state or wire type changes, so replays, golden and fuzz runs are untouched.
- **Hidden information:** the last Spell, chains and homes are public. Only the seat's own hand and graveyard are read. The search keeps working on redacted or determinized states (README; CLAUDE.md rule 7, R185).
- **Search behaviour:** boards with Echo, a chain, a Dormant card or an animated card now give more distinct children. The daily gates measure that; the per-PR AI suites passed on the scratch build. `copies_text` does a registry lookup per hand and graveyard card per signature, which is cheap next to a `reduce`.
- **#4793 conflict:** it edits `card_signature` a few lines away. Whichever lands second rebases; do not port its part.
- **Part letters:** `V` is a new part letter, not used elsewhere. Each part appears only when non-default, so every existing exact-signature test keeps passing.
````
